PASS on the fake backend, final gate run. Served device mhs://localhost/bimanual-kitchen, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0 (the card's floor and the floor of cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1). The served model is the card's models[0], models/kitchen_scene.xml, read in place from the pinned clone (robots/froststar16/bimanual-cooking-sim/models/kitchen_scene.xml; never copied, imported, installed or modified): two 7-DOF arms, 14 hinge joints, 14 motor actuators with ctrlrange -80 to 80 inherited from the nested arm_actuator default class (models/kitchen_scene.xml:23-24), timestep 0.002 s with implicitfast, and no keyframe. The bridge derives action.ctrl's per-actuator bounds from the loaded model and publishes them; the package writes no Limit of its own. The fake backend is fake.py, a callable stand-in mujoco module that parses the same MJCF for the step, the coordinate counts and the actuator ctrlranges and integrates a placeholder first-order motion, so the gate reports the expected simulator-family warnings G6.NOT_RECORDED, G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND and G8.NO_UNIT x3 (ticks, action.ctrl[*] and the reset seed, which the family derives and a package cannot describe). G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo engine was not installed and was never run; the fake computes no inertias, contacts, friction loss, armature, gravity or actuator dynamics, so its trajectories are not MuJoCo results; only models/kitchen_scene.xml is served and the clone's pan_flip, pan_pour, bottle, cook and omelette_* scenes are not exposed; no rendering, cameras or sensor streams are served; snapshot and restore are advertised through the bridge but are not exercised by the CL3 gate; the upstream-sim path (a backend name not listed in backends, which imports the real mujoco module and loads the same model) was not run; no physical robot or kitchen is modelled and no hardware run is claimed. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null).
